data.name: Emaaan
data.gender_notes: Emaaan is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Emaaan is an Arabic name that symbolizes faith and trust in Allah. It is a vital aspect of a Muslim's life and is considered one of the pillars of Islam. The name Emaaan carries the meaning “Faith and Belief” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Emaaan usually hope their child will grow to embody faith and belief and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In the Quran, Emaaan is mentioned as one of the essential qualities of a true believer (Quran 2:285)
data.etymology: Emaaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Faith and Belief.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Emaaan total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
